name: Hana Tazenaki
source: Hana is a high school senior with quite the resume: student council president, chart-topping test grades, and quite the athlete too. All of that signed and sealed with her cute smile to boot. However, Little Miss Perfect isn’t all as she seems. Despite her admirers and rivals thinking otherwise, all she really wants to do is laze around – spending the little free time she has fulfilling her curiosities with games and manga. Understandably, this is a side of herself kept neatly tucked away for the sake of her ‘public image’.
